source_title: MEDKids Ears starter card (demonstration data, unreviewed)
primary_objective: How ears help us hear and balance
educational_content: Ears help us hear sounds. Sound goes into the ear as tiny waves. The eardrum moves when sound waves hit it. The ear sends sound messages to the brain. Parts deep inside the ear help us keep our balance.
learning_objectives: The ear sends sound messages to the brain.
Parts inside the ear help us keep our balance.

forbidden_claims.claim: Loud music is good for your ears
Earwax is dirt that must be dug out
